set_desc: Short task suite: 55 tasks × 2 trials, run on every tool (550 runs). These are very short tasks. A modern coding agent does them quickly and easily, so they look more like simple questions than real coding work, and the differences between tools here are not very statistically significant.
set_tested: 55 short tasks across small to large repositories, each run twice per tool. Claude Sonnet 5.5 (high effort) in Claude Code 2.1.293. Tool versions: graphify 0.9.95, ponytail 5.3.2, caveman upstream 1f951fb (CAVEMAN_DEFAULT_MODE=caveman), rtk 1.0.1.
interpretation_note: Note on interpretation: cost differences between conditions include everything the model does differently when a tool is active (extra turns, extra tool calls, sub-agent delegation). Delegation to sub-agents is model behaviour that a tool can change; it is not a benchmark setting or an error, and no cost difference in this file is attributed to it. A difference whose 95% range (change_ci_low to change_ci_high) includes 0 could be noise and is not a confirmed difference.
